whats_new: Zerg Router models use your Router sign-in in every pane, and when Router cuts an answer off, ZTC asks again and keeps what arrived.
Claude Code and Codex panes you open skip permission prompts unless set to ask in /settings, and /claude uses this computer's sign-in.
/ztc opens ZTC beside this pane; agents open ZTC workers on models they name and give them their task as a message, never as a command.
Main stays open in the desktop app, and without sign-in the browser mirror answers only this computer and the link ZTC gives it.
changes: An answer Zerg Router cuts off is asked for again, and what arrived stays.
The web mirror drops an answer ZTC asks the model again for.
A ZTC pane an agent opens gets the agent's task as its first message.
A ZTC worker an agent opens on the route new panes start on is checked on Zerg Router's list for your current sign-in.
A ZTC worker an agent opens on Zerg Router needs your current Router sign-in.
The MCP SDK's hono web server packages are updated past moderate advisories.
